title: Strong error analysis of a temporal approximation for stochastic Korteweg-de Vries equation with small additive noise
summary: We study strong temporal approximation of periodic stochastic Korteweg--de Vries equation driven by small additive \(Q\)-Wiener noise of amplitude \(\mathcal O(\varepsilon)\), \(0<\varepsilon\ll1\). Strong error analysis for temporal approximations of stochastic KdV is a challenging problem, due to the additional derivative term in the nonlinearity and thanks to the lack of suitable exponential moment bounds for the exact solutions.
